# Layer `dotnet-library`

Rules only for NuGet libraries: package metadata, public API tracking, trimming and AOT, publishing to GitHub Packages and NuGet.org.

Read the files that apply to everything before any task, and the others when you work on the paths they apply to.

| File | Applies to | Topics |
| --- | --- | --- |
| @packages.instructions.md | everything | NuGet packages |
| @publicapi.instructions.md | `**/*.cs`, `**/PublicAPI.*.txt` | Public API in .NET: Documentation, Tracking |
| @releases.instructions.md | everything | NuGet releases |
| @trimming.instructions.md | `**/*.cs`, `**/*.csproj` | Trimming, AOT, and the browser |
